messages:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: PAGER: gpu-pool eu-west-1 at 95% GPU util, queue length ~3x baseline, autoscaler attempted scale but failed (scale_limit hit). Paging @jordan @oncall-eng. Incident ID: INC-2026-0453
Jordan: Oncall here, taking it. Quick pulse: what's the customer impact? Any 5xx/429 spikes?
Sam: Seeing elevated 429s and some 5xx for hosted endpoints. Tail latency increased. Quick log snippet:
```
2026-03-17T02:12:30Z ERROR request_handler - 429 TooManyRequests target=hosted-gen model=redwood-1q
queue_size=842 baseline=240
```
Sam: A lot of short low-priority jobs are backing up, but also some production PLG customers are hitting throttles.
Lee: Checking autoscaler: cloud API returned QuotaExceeded / 403 on scale request. Also found autoscaler config had scale_limit=4 (old deploy). Investigating if scale attempts were rate-limited by provider.
Devon: I tried a manual scale (+4 nodes) but cloud API responded with 403 Quota limit. I can open a quota request with provider (will take hours). Short-term mitigation: evict low-priority queued jobs and enable fallback routing to `redwood-llm-small` for non-enterprise tenants.
Maria: Support alerted. Early indicator list: acme-inc, beta-app, internal-staging showing degraded performance. Preparing a customer-facing status blurb.
Jordan: Plan: 1) Devon — evict low-prio queues and prepare fallback switch. 2) Lee — validate autoscaler logs and retry scale, check provider errors. 3) Sam — execute Mitigation runbook (eviction + routing) and collect logs. 4) Maria — post initial status and coordinate comms. I'll join bridge.
Lee: Bridge created: https://call.example.com/bridge/INC-2026-0453
Devon: Running eviction: `./evict-lowprio --pool eu-west-1 --threshold 0.6` -> freed estimated 6 GPU-equivalent tasks, queue reduced from ~842 -> ~180.
Sam: Enabled fallback routing for non-enterprise routes to `redwood-llm-small`. Immediate p95 latency improved; monitoring for errors.
Jordan: Any remaining customer-facing failures? Maria?
Maria: acme reported degraded performance but service still reachable. Support to escalate if errors spike. Posting status now.
OpsBot: :white_check_mark: Autoscaler retry at 02:38Z succeeded partially: added 2 nodes. Pool util down to ~82%.
Lee: Follow-up discovery: autoscaler config still had a legacy `scale_limit=4` from a prior emergency change. I opened a PR to raise to 12 and added guardrail checks to avoid silent failures. PR: https://git.internal/r/infra/1234
Jordan: Action items for postmortem (owners):
- Increase cloud quota / pre-approve scale limits with provider (Devon)
- Add early-warning alert (75% util + queue growth X2) and a cool-down metric for noisy tenants (Lee)
- Implement automated low-priority eviction runbook + one-click fallback routing (Sam)
- Harden autoscaler error handling (exponential retry + explicit failure alerts) (Lee)
- Improve customer comms template for capacity blips (Maria)
Jordan: Please ack individual ownership.
Sam: Ack :thumbsup:
Lee: Ack
Devon: Ack. Opened provider quota ticket #Q-4591, ETA 6-12h.
Maria: Posting status: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-2026-0453 — included known impact and mitigations.
Jordan: Handing to day-shift oncall for continued follow-up and postmortem. I'll draft initial incident notes and timeline. Good quick response — follow-up required to avoid recurrence. :handshake:
